description: Flagsmith feature-flag connector (read-only). Surfaces feature-flag definitions across all projects — name, type, default-enabled, initial value, description, tags, archived state, owner count, and timestamps — into the local index as `flagsmith:feature_flag` items, useful for incident correlation ("did this flag exist when the alert fired?"). Admin-API-token auth (`Authorization: Token <token>`). Regional / self-hosted instances override `flagsmith.api_base` (default https://api.flagsmith.com); the SaaS API host (api.flagsmith.com) is the only one in the static sandbox manifest today. v1 indexes flag definitions only — per-environment on/off state + segments are a deferred follow-up. The `flagsmith.flag.toggle` write tool is a deferred Phase 8 follow-up.
author: Nimbus
